features.title: Plugin System
features.description: First-class plugins with a scoped API and nine granular permissions. Drop a folder into ~/.draftflow/plugins/, declare capabilities in plugin.json, and extend the editor.

features.title: Lifecycle events
features.description: Plugins subscribe to file:opened, file:saved, send:triggered, theme:changed, and app:ready — react to exactly what they need.

features.title: Plugin toolbar
features.description: Each loaded plugin gets its own mount point in a dedicated toolbar strip between the editor toolbar and content area. Hidden automatically when no plugins are loaded.

features.title: What's New modal
features.description: See new features automatically on first launch after an update, or revisit any time via Help → What's New.

features.title: Markdown editor
features.description: Distraction-free writing with live split-pane preview. Edit / split / preview modes. Mermaid diagram rendering.

features.title: Skill autocomplete
features.description: Type # to fuzzy-search skills, / for agents. Hover to preview a skill without leaving the editor.

features.title: Claude Code bridge
features.description: Open files directly from Claude Code, edit them, and send the result back with one click.

features.title: Token counter
features.description: Real-time token count powered by @anthropic-ai/tokenizer. Know your context before you send.

features.title: Project tree
features.description: Browse all files rooted at the nearest CLAUDE.md. Recent files panel. Quick-open palette via ⌘P.

features.title: Scratchpad
features.description: Persistent scratch space separate from your draft. Auto-saved to ~/.claude/draftflow-scratch.md.

features.title: Suggested skills
features.description: As you type, relevant skills surface as chips below the editor — no trigger needed. Powered by claude-haiku-4-5. Silently off without an API key.
